title: Defy Gravity
description: Discover the mind-bending science of quantum levitation

scenes.narration: Imagine a world where objects float in mid-air
Welcome to the world of quantum levitation
Scientists use magnetic fields to suspend objects
This phenomenon is made possible by superconductors
Which can conduct electricity with zero resistance
The result is a mind-bending defiance of gravity

title: Defy Gravity
description: Mind-bending quantum levitation explained in under 1 minute

scenes.narration: Imagine an object floating in mid-air, defying gravity
This is quantum levitation, made possible by superconductors
When superconductors are cooled, they expel magnetic fields
Creating an upward force that counteracts gravity
The result is a frictionless, gravity-defying environment
Where objects can float, and even move, without touching anything
The future of transportation and technology, reinvented
